integrity: Self-contained algebraic proof; exhaustive finite checker for the stated small cases and the first-threshold enumeration; not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Classification is confined to two-block Schur partitions of finite rectangular bands; no general classification for partitions with more than two blocks or arbitrary semigroups is claimed. Literature equivalences may remain undiscovered.
title: Two-block Schur rings of rectangular bands: biregularity and the sharp non-automorphic threshold
